Description: Deductions are never subtracted from gross salary. total_deductions is always inserted as 0 — every payroll run produces net salary = gross salary regardless of configured deductions.
Suggested Fix: Parse deductions JSON object; sum all component values; subtract from gross to produce correct net_salary and total_deductions.

Description: getMonthlySummary CTE uses wrong column names start_date/end_date on leave_requests — correct names are from_date/to_date. Leave days are never counted in LOP calculation.
Suggested Fix: Change lr.start_date → lr.from_date and lr.end_date → lr.to_date throughout the leave_requests join.

Description: saveSalary always calls POST /admin/payroll/salaries regardless of edit vs create. Editing a salary creates a duplicate record instead of updating the existing one.
Suggested Fix: Add updateSalary(id) method calling PUT /admin/payroll/salaries/:id. In handleEditSalary use updateSalary instead of saveSalary.

Description: fetchLeaveTypes reads res?.data?.leaveTypes but leaveService.getLeaveTypes already unwraps axios data layer — correct path is res?.leaveTypes. Result: leave type dropdown is always empty for all users.
Suggested Fix: Change to: setLeaveTypes((res?.leaveTypes || res?.data?.leaveTypes || []).filter(t => t.isActive !== false))

Description: TOCTOU race in resetPassword: verifyOTP resets attempt counter but does not delete the row; then a second plaintext OTP check re-queries with email+otp_code. Two concurrent calls both pass verifyOTP then both fire UPDATE — password can be reset twice. Also leaks timing info.
Suggested Fix: After verifyOTP succeeds DELETE the password_resets row immediately and carry tenant/user_type in the return value. Remove the second otp_code WHERE clause entirely.

Description: Fallback LIMIT 1 login query: when the exact email is not found but matches the tenant registry email the code returns the FIRST active admin user ordered by id ASC. An attacker who knows a tenant's registered email can authenticate as the oldest admin account using any correct password.
Suggested Fix: Remove the fallback query entirely. Return null if exact email match fails.

Description: Employee auto-provisioning (INSERT INTO employees) fires before the MFA challenge check. MFA is required but employee side-effects already occurred. If INSERT fails on a non-work_email constraint the error is swallowed and employeeId stays null — JWT embeds employeeId: null breaking all employee-linked actions silently.
Suggested Fix: Move MFA check before the auto-provisioning block. Propagate INSERT failures instead of swallowing them.

Description: resolveEmployeeId() can return null/undefined. The guard `if (employeeId) await assertActiveForPunch(...)` silently skips the active-employee check when falsy then passes 0 (Number(null)) into DB queries — a semantically wrong lookup.
Suggested Fix: Add `if (!employeeId) throw ApiError.badRequest('Unable to identify employee')` before assertActiveForPunch in both checkIn and checkOut.

Description: checkOut has no guard against double check-out. An employee can call the endpoint repeatedly and overwrite their checkout time corrupting overtime calculations. checkIn already had this guard.
Suggested Fix: Add `if (existing?.check_out_time && !canManageOverride(auth)) throw ApiError.badRequest(...)` after the existing check-in guard.

Description: IDOR in getPayslipDetail: ownership check is `if (employeeId && ...)` — when req.user.employeeId is undefined (admin with no linked employee record) the condition short-circuits and any user with PAYROLL_VIEW can read any payslip.
Suggested Fix: Replace with explicit auth-context check: users with PAYROLL_MANAGE or isTenantAdmin bypass; everyone else must own the payslip; missing employeeId throws 403.

Description: Auth bypass in applyLeave: guard is `if (!canApplyForOthers && auth?.employeeId)` — when auth.employeeId is null the condition is false so the caller-supplied data.employeeId is accepted unchecked. Any user with no linked employee record can submit leave for any employee ID.
Suggested Fix: If !canApplyForOthers: throw 403 if employeeId missing; then force data.employeeId = auth.employeeId.

Description: Wrong FK stored in approval audit columns: user.id (auth account ID referencing auth_users) stored in manager_approved_by/hr_approved_by which are FK columns referencing employees.id. Causes silent wrong values or FK violations.
Suggested Fix: Change actorId to: user.employeeId || null

Description: upsertSalary accepts arbitrary employee_id from request body with no validation. PAYROLL_MANAGE user can set salaries for any employee_id including cross-tenant IDs. No validation that net_salary is numeric.
Suggested Fix: Add numeric validation for employee_id and net_salary; add DB lookup confirming employee exists in this tenant (deleted_at IS NULL) before upsert.

Description: Employee query for payroll runs does not filter soft-deleted employees (missing deleted_at IS NULL). Terminated/Resigned excluded by employment_status but soft-deleted accounts without a status change are still included.
Suggested Fix: Add `AND e.deleted_at IS NULL` to the employee WHERE clause.

Description: createChangeRequest uses data.employee_id || user.employeeId without verifying caller has permission to submit on behalf of another employee. Any employee with SHIFT_CHANGE_REQUEST permission can create a request for any other employee ID.
Suggested Fix: If data.employee_id differs from user.employeeId require SHIFT_MANAGE permission or admin role; throw ApiError.forbidden otherwise.

Description: listChangeRequests accepts filters.employeeId from query string without authorization. Any employee with SHIFT_VIEW can enumerate all other employees' shift-change requests — classic IDOR.
Suggested Fix: If filters.employeeId differs from auth.employeeId and caller lacks SHIFT_MANAGE or admin role force filters.employeeId = auth.employeeId.

Description: Route ordering bug: POST /seed is defined AFTER GET /:calendarId. Express matches /:calendarId first for the string 'seed' routing POST /seed to ctrl.detail with calendarId='seed'. The isInt validator rejects 'seed' with 400 — POST /seed is permanently unreachable.
Suggested Fix: Move `router.post('/seed'
column10: ...)` so the static path matches first.

Description: handleDeleteSalary is a stub that always shows toast.error('Delete not yet supported'). The Delete button is fully visible in production — users think deletion failed when the feature was never wired up.
Suggested Fix: Implement payrollService.deleteSalary(id) calling DELETE /admin/payroll/salaries/:id and call fetchSalaries() after success.

Description: All Payslip buttons in the Employee Salary tab navigate to '/admin/payroll-engine' unconditionally with no employee context. Every row opens the same generic page.
Suggested Fix: Either set payslipRow to the salary row to trigger the existing modal or navigate with: navigate('/admin/payroll-engine' { state: { employeeId: row.employee_id } })

Description: Export Report button has no onClick handler and no implementation — clicking it does nothing with no user feedback.
Suggested Fix: Implement export via attendanceService export functions; add loading state; wire onClick.

Description: Remind button for missing check-outs calls toast.success('Reminder sent') with no API call. The reminder is never actually sent to the employee — only a fake success toast is shown.
Suggested Fix: Implement POST /attendance/remind-checkout/:employeeId API endpoint and call it. Show toast only on actual success.

Description: listEmployees response destructured as d?.records || d || [] but attendanceService.listEmployees returns { employees: [...] }. The 'records' key does not exist — employees dropdown may receive the raw response object instead of an array.
Suggested Fix: Change to: setEmployees(d?.employees || d?.records || [])

Description: Live leave balance never fetches because the useEffect watches form.leaveType but EMPTY_FORM does not have a 'leaveType' key (it has 'leaveTypeId'). form.leaveType is always undefined — effect never fires on leave type selection.
Suggested Fix: Either add leaveType: '' to EMPTY_FORM and set it in the picker or change the effect dependency to watch form.leaveTypeId.

Description: isOwn() uses user?.employeeId ?? user?.id — user.id fallback is the auth account ID not the employee ID. Admin with no linked employee record gets compared against account ID causing incorrect segregation-of-duties enforcement.
Suggested Fix: Guard: if (!user?.employeeId) return false — admins without employee records cannot own an overtime request.

Description: updateOvertime calls PATCH /attendance/overtime/:id but processOvertime calls PATCH /attendance/:id/overtime — two different URL patterns for overlapping operations. One of them will always 404.
Suggested Fix: Not a bug — verified: /overtime/:id maps to edit (updateOvertime) and /:id/overtime maps to approve/reject (processOvertime). Both routes exist and are correct.

Description: Escaped template literals in HTML email body: \\${cycle.cycle_name} and \\${deadlineStr} render as literal placeholder text instead of actual values. The subject line interpolates correctly but HTML body shows broken placeholders.
Suggested Fix: Remove the backslashes: \\${cycle.cycle_name} → ${cycle.cycle_name} and \\${deadlineStr} → ${deadlineStr}

Description: requested_shift_id has ON DELETE CASCADE. Deleting a shift definition silently deletes the full history of all shift-change requests and approvals for that shift — destroying the audit trail.
Suggested Fix: Change ON DELETE CASCADE to ON DELETE RESTRICT on requested_shift_id. Add soft-delete to shifts table if needed.

Description: payslip_number VARCHAR(50) has no UNIQUE constraint. Two payroll runs can generate payslips with the same reference number breaking accounting integrity and making payslip_number unusable as an external reference.
Suggested Fix: Add: ALTER TABLE payslips ADD CONSTRAINT uq_payslip_number UNIQUE (payslip_number); and handle conflicts in payslip generation code.

Description: approvePayrollRun accepts COMPLETED as a valid status to transition from — a run whose payslips were already generated can be re-approved.
Suggested Fix: Change allowed-status guard to ['DRAFT' 'PROCESSING'] only.

Description: verify2FA() is dead code (no route wires it up) but contains a wrong query: queries public.tenants WHERE id = $1 using userId (admin_users.id) not a tenant row ID. If wired up it would silently return wrong TOTP secrets.
Suggested Fix: Remove verify2FA entirely; it is superseded by verifyMfaLogin.

Description: impersonationCodes is an in-process Map. In multi-process/multi-instance deployments (PM2 cluster Kubernetes) a code issued by one process cannot be redeemed by another. Expired codes also accumulate indefinitely.
Suggested Fix: Store impersonation codes in Redis or a DB table with TTL. Call prune on redemption as well as issuance.

Description: issueRefreshToken does not store tenant_id or db_name in the DB row — only in the JWT payload. verifyAndRotateRefreshToken re-fetches user data using payload.db_name from the (potentially attacker-supplied) token claims without server-side cross-checking.
Suggested Fix: Add tenant_id and db_name columns to public.refresh_tokens and verify them server-side during rotation rejecting mismatching claims.

Description: Login handler sends access token both as httpOnly cookie AND as plain JSON body field `token: accessToken`. JavaScript can read the body token defeating the XSS protection of httpOnly cookies.
Suggested Fix: Remove `token: accessToken` from the JSON response body. Clients should rely solely on the httpOnly cookie.

Description: Race condition in notifyHolidayEvent: wasAlreadySent check and recordSent insert are not atomic. Two concurrent calls both pass the check before either writes to history — duplicate notifications sent to all recipients.
Suggested Fix: Invert pattern: attempt INSERT first. If rowCount === 0 (conflict) skip the send. This is atomic and race-free.

Description: getEmployeeCurrentShift uses `esa.effective_to >= NOW()` but effective_to is a DATE. Postgres coerces the date to midnight — NOW() mid-day is after midnight of effective_to when effective_to == today. Shift assignments expiring today are incorrectly treated as expired mid-day.
Suggested Fix: Change to `esa.effective_to >= CURRENT_DATE` so assignments on their last calendar day are returned throughout that day.

Description: In actOnChangeRequest if current_stage is 'done' and status is 'Pending' the code silently repairs stage to stages[0] allowing an HR user to re-approve an already-concluded request — state-machine bypass.
Suggested Fix: If current_stage is 'done' throw ApiError.badRequest('Change request is already concluded') rather than silently repairing the stage.

Description: countUnread() calls listNotifications() and filters in JavaScript. For superadmin with many tenants this triggers N sequential DB queries and loads up to 100*N notification objects into memory just to return a badge count. This endpoint is polled frequently.
Suggested Fix: Implement dedicated `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications WHERE is_read = false AND <userScope>` query bypassing the full list fetch.

Description: Welcome email sends plain-text adminPassword to the tenant admin. Raw passwords in email expose credentials if the email channel is compromised. If email fails the admin has no password and no recovery path.
Suggested Fix: Send only the login URL and a one-time password-reset link expiring in 24 hours. Never transmit raw passwords via email.

Description: useEffect for data re-fetch has wrong dependencies: monthly tab does not re-fetch when selectedMonth changes alone (Load button needed). If user navigates away and returns stale data can show for previously loaded month.
Suggested Fix: Split into two separate useEffects. Ensure fetchMonthlySummary is also called when [selectedMonth] changes if mainTab === 'monthly'.

Description: Payroll Items table uses global 'loading' state set by initial employee/salary fetch instead of a dedicated loading state for payroll items. Items visually appear to finish loading prematurely.
Suggested Fix: Add const [itemsLoading setItemsLoading] = useState(false) set it in fetchPayrollItems and pass it to the Table component.

Description: Monthly Payroll table 'Gross Salary' column renders fmt(Number(row.net_salary)) — the configured base salary not a computed gross. Users see same number in both 'Gross Salary' and 'Net Pay' when there is no LOP.
Suggested Fix: Rename column to 'Base Salary' or pass actual gross field from backend.

Description: PENDING RECORDS KPI computes Math.max(0 employees.length - salaries.length) but salaries are filtered by current searchTerm/dept filter. Count is artificially inflated when filters are active.
Suggested Fix: Fetch salaries without filters for the KPI count or compute pending only from unfiltered API total.

Description: handleSubmit calls submitRegularization with no client-side validation: date can be empty reason can be blank check-in time can be after check-out time. Blank/invalid data passes silently to API.
Suggested Fix: Add validation: require date require reason and verify checkInTime < checkOutTime before calling API. Mark reason as required.

Description: handleAction (approve/reject) sets component-level 'error' state on failure but the action modal does not render the error inside it. If approve/reject fails the modal stays open with no visible error.
Suggested Fix: Add local actionError state and render it inside the action modal.

Description: buildReportColumns(rows[0]) is called with the first row to infer columns. When rows is empty rows[0] is undefined. If buildReportColumns does not handle undefined gracefully it will throw crashing the table render.
Suggested Fix: Guard: const columns = buildReportColumns(rows.length > 0 ? rows[0] : null). Ensure buildReportColumns handles null/undefined by returning default columns.

Description: KPI stat cards display hard-coded denominators: / 9 (daily hours) / 40 (weekly) / 160 (monthly) / 28 (overtime). Not pulled from shift/attendance settings. Wrong for organisations using different work schedules.
Suggested Fix: Pull shift hours and expected monthly hours from useAttendanceSettings hook. Use settings.workingHoursPerDay and settings.overtimeSettings.monthlyCapHours as denominators.

Description: refreshMonth has a silent empty catch block. If monthly attendance fetch fails user sees no error — the table simply disappears or stays empty.
Suggested Fix: Add error state: catch (err) { setMonthError(err?.response?.data?.message || 'Failed to load attendance history'); setMonthData({ records: [] summary: null }); }

Description: canApprove and canApply missing org-admin bypass. Admin with no specific 'leave.approve' RBAC slug sees the leave module but has no approve/apply buttons. Inconsistent with attendance and overtime pages that grant admin full rights.
Suggested Fix: Add: const isOrgAdmin = user?.role === 'admin'; const canApprove = canApproveLeave(allowedModules) || isOrgAdmin;

Description: fetchBalances triggers only when activeTab === 'balances' but no 'balances' tab is rendered in JSX. The Balances tab is completely missing from the rendered tab bar — balancesPage/fetchBalances/loadingBal are dead code.
Suggested Fix: Either add a 'balances' tab to the tab array and render the balances table or remove all dead balancesPage/fetchBalances/loadingBal state and the conditional effect.

Description: validate() only checks that startTime and endTime are non-empty strings. Does not validate endTime > startTime. A user can create a shift like 18:00-09:00 (inverted times) without warning which can break attendance calculations.
Suggested Fix: Add: if (form.startTime && form.endTime && form.startTime >= form.endTime) e.endTime = 'End time must be after start time';

Description: Column `reminder_5d_sent` is named as if it fires 5 days before deadline but the query window is `due_at <= NOW() + INTERVAL '2 days'`. The flag name misleads developers — either wrong name or wrong interval.
Suggested Fix: Either rename column to reminder_2d_sent via migration or change INTERVAL back to '5 days' to match the column name.

Description: tasks table created with no indexes on assignee_id due_date or status. tasksReminder.job queries with date range and status filters. On large tenants this is a full sequential scan every hour per tenant.
Suggested Fix: Add in new migration: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tasks_assignee ON tasks(assignee_id); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tasks_due_status ON tasks(due_date status) WHERE is_deleted = FALSE;

Description: Four `ALTER TABLE tasks ADD COLUMN` statements have no `IF NOT EXISTS` guard. Re-running this migration fails with 'column already exists' error leaving the tenant in a partially-migrated state.
Suggested Fix: Add IF NOT EXISTS to all four ALTER TABLE statements.

Description: approval_delegations table missing index on delegate_employee_id. Most common query is 'find active delegations where this employee is the delegate' — full table scan without index.
Suggested Fix: Add: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_approval_delegations_delegate ON approval_delegations (delegate_employee_id is_active);

Description: locations.code column VARCHAR(50) has no UNIQUE constraint. Duplicate location codes can be inserted and silently misrouted in any code that looks up a location by code.
Suggested Fix: Add: ALTER TABLE locations ADD CONSTRAINT uq_locations_code UNIQUE (code); (or partial unique index WHERE code IS NOT NULL)

Description: leave_encashment_requests.leave_type and leave_accrual_ledger.leave_type are VARCHAR(100) free-text with no FK to leave_types table. Records become orphaned with stale names if a leave type is renamed or deleted.
Suggested Fix: Add leave_type_id INTEGER REFERENCES leave_types(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT columns and backfill from the text column.

Description: runTenantMigrations is called on every cron tick for every active tenant. Slow or large migrations block attendance-processing for that tenant and cascade delays to all subsequent tenants in the loop.
Suggested Fix: Run runTenantMigrations exclusively at tenant-provisioning time and at application startup not inside the cron loop.

Description: findById hard-codes NULL::varchar AS shift_name instead of joining to shifts table. Migration 137 added attendance.shift_id FK. shift_name is always NULL for any caller (payslip generation attendance detail view).
Suggested Fix: Add LEFT JOIN shifts sh ON sh.id = a.shift_id and replace NULL::varchar AS shift_name with sh.name AS shift_name.

Description: approval_requests.module is VARCHAR(50) free-text without CHECK constraint even though approval_workflows.module has an explicit CHECK constraint limiting values to the same enum. Arbitrary module strings can be inserted.
Suggested Fix: Add same CHECK constraint to approval_requests.module: CHECK (module IN ('leave' 'overtime' 'regularization' 'expense' 'shift_change'))

Description: N+1 pattern: escalation loop calls pool.connect() per-row opens a transaction executes 2-3 queries then calls notifySlaBreach which fires 2-4 more pool queries per recipient. Unbounded pool connection usage per cron tick.
Suggested Fix: Batch DB writes: collect all escalation updates into single multi-row INSERT/UPDATE in one transaction. Move notifications to async queue after all DB writes complete.

Description: POST /mfa/disable validator marks `code` as `.optional()` which is misleading — code IS required when MFA is enabled. Could confuse maintainers into weakening enforcement.
Suggested Fix: Use .optional({ checkFalsy: true }) and add a comment explaining code is only required when MFA is currently enabled.

Description: createDate updateDate and removeDate pass req.user.db_name as both `dbName` and `tenantDb` parameters — they are always identical. The distinction is meaningless and misleading.
Suggested Fix: Pass a single dbName and remove the redundant tenantDb parameter.

Description: loadSeedData() calls fs.readFileSync synchronously on every invocation blocking the Node.js event loop. If the seed file does not exist it throws an unhandled synchronous exception with an opaque ENOENT message.
Suggested Fix: Cache seed data in a module-level variable after first read. Wrap readFileSync in try/catch and throw a descriptive ApiError.

Description: buildUserScope calls ensureMessagingEmployeeId (a DB query) with no try/catch. If that query fails the error propagates and causes the entire mark-read/delete operation to fail with 500.
Suggested Fix: Wrap ensureMessagingEmployeeId in try/catch inside buildUserScope and default messagingEmpId to null on error.

Description: tenantMigrationsReady is a module-level Set that is never cleared. If a new migration file is added without a process restart tenant DBs already cached in the Set skip the new migration. In rolling restarts some nodes apply the migration and others do not.
Suggested Fix: Document this trade-off explicitly or implement cache invalidation by hashing the migrations directory contents and re-checking when hash changes.

Description: handleSearch uses clearTimeout(debounceRef.current) but debounceRef.current is never cleared on component unmount. If the component unmounts while a debounce timer is pending the timer fires and calls load() on an unmounted component.
Suggested Fix: Add cleanup: useEffect(() => () => clearTimeout(debounceRef.current) []);

Description: loadKpis and load both call getOvertimeRecords({ limit: 200 }) on mount and after every action — two identical API calls fired simultaneously. KPI and table data are always the same.
Suggested Fix: Combine into a single fetch: load records once and compute KPI counts from the result inside the same callback.

Description: approve action button uses variant='Approve' (capital-A). Inconsistent with rest of app variants ('teal' 'danger' etc). Will silently fall through to wrong style if Button.jsx is refactored.
Suggested Fix: Rename the Button variant from 'Approve' to 'success' or 'emerald' in Button.jsx and update all call sites.

Description: `SELECT * FROM tenants WHERE status = 'active'` overfetches all columns including potentially sensitive data. Only db_name and id are needed.
Suggested Fix: Replace with: SELECT id db_name FROM tenants WHERE status = 'active'

File: src/jobs/leaveCarryForward.job.js, src/jobs/exitSlaEscalation.job.js, src/jobs/exitTaskReminder.job.js and 7 other job files
Description: Ten job files call `await getTenantPool(...)` but getTenantPool is synchronous. Harmless now but misleads readers and will silently break if the implementation is ever made async.
Suggested Fix: Remove `await` from all call sites: `const pool = getTenantPool(tenant.db_name);`

Description: payslips.pay_period_id has no explicit ON DELETE clause (defaults to NO ACTION) while the sibling payroll_runs.pay_period_id uses ON DELETE RESTRICT. Inconsistent semantics. No index on payslips.pay_period_id causing join scans.
Suggested Fix: Add ON DELETE RESTRICT explicitly and: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_payslips_pay_period ON payslips (pay_period_id);

Description: Stage-status columns (manager_status hr_status current_stage) added without CHECK constraints. Any value including typos can be written without error.
Suggested Fix: Add CHECK constraints: ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS manager_status VARCHAR(20) CHECK (manager_status IN ('Pending' 'Approved' 'Rejected' 'Skipped')) etc.

Description: Absent records were created without stamping shift_id so reports could not determine which shift was missed. Also the old code passed the entire record object to logCron.newValue potentially logging sensitive data.
Suggested Fix: After upsert resolve the employee's shift and stamp shift_id via UPDATE WHERE shift_id IS NULL. (Fixed in recent session — verify deployment.)

Description: COMPLETED payroll runs re-approvable — the allowed-status guard included COMPLETED as a valid state to transition from meaning already-generated payslips could be re-triggered. (Fixed in Agent 1 pass — verify deployment.)
Suggested Fix: Change allowed-status guard to ['DRAFT' 'PROCESSING'] only.
